The '''Krenhner system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Krenhner sector/Legends|Krenhner sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Krenhner]].
